samples.title: Content Creator & Editor / Social Creative Manager
samples.description:

Our brands include Icy Hot, Aspercreme, Unisom, Dulcolax, Cortizone 10, Allegra, Xyzal and more. Each creator will be assigned two brands. This role touches every part of the creative process, from trend spotting and pitching ideas to concepting, shooting, editing and creating platform native content.

samples.description:

This role will be the connective tissue across our social creative team, owning the process from intake and prioritization through production and delivery while keeping teams, timelines, and resources moving in the right direction.
